1. In X, go to Settings → Your account → Download an archive of your data.
2. After receiving the archive, open the Bookmarks file and copy its contents (the JSON list).
3. Paste them above and tap Import.

refundConsent.title: Updated terms
refundConsent.disclosure: We have updated our terms to cover Apple refund reviews. By agreeing below, you accept the updated terms and allow Shelvr, through RevenueCat, to share purchase and delivery information with Apple when you request a refund. Apple makes the final decision. Your saved links, notes, and photos are not shared.
